name: Programming Laboratory
lead: Equipped with high-performance workstations supporting modern programming languages, IDEs, and development toolchains.
systems: 60 Intel Core i7 Systems with 32GB RAM & NVMe SSDs
focus: Algorithm design, data structures implementation, OOP paradigms, and collaborative software engineering.

name: Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
lead: Dedicated computing facility for neural network modeling, computer vision, natural language processing, and deep learning research.
systems: High-Density GPU Workstations with NVIDIA RTX Ada Generation accelerators
focus: Model training, generative AI exploration, predictive analytics, and computer vision pipelines.

name: Cloud Computing Laboratory
lead: Hands-on virtualization and cloud orchestration environment for deploying scalable, distributed microservices.
systems: Private OpenStack Cloud Cluster & Dedicated High-Speed Gigabit Uplinks
focus: Virtual machine management, container orchestration, continuous deployment (CI/CD), and serverless architectures.

name: Networking Laboratory
lead: Cisco-equipped hardware laboratory designed for network configuration, packet analysis, and telecommunications simulations.
systems: Modular Network Racks, Managed L2/L3 Switches, and Dedicated Test Benches
focus: Routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), subnetting, firewall configuration, network diagnostics, and traffic monitoring.

name: Cyber Security Laboratory
lead: Sandboxed threat modeling and vulnerability testing lab for hands-on ethical hacking and digital forensics.
systems: Air-gapped isolated virtual network segments with defensive telemetry tools
focus: Penetration testing, cryptography implementation, digital forensics analysis, and vulnerability assessment.

name: Database & Big Data Laboratory
lead: Enterprise data management environment for relational databases, distributed data lakes, and business intelligence.
systems: High-throughput storage arrays and memory-optimized database instances
focus: Query optimization, indexing strategies, ACID vs. BASE models, distributed data processing, and analytical dashboards.
